needed.policy_yaml:
# Supervisor policy for agent credit_prequal - generated by the Onboarding Agent.
# Review every rule. Replace each FILL-ME-approver with two named approvers before
# merge. The agent starts in SHADOW: rules are evaluated and recorded, nothing is
# blocked until a rule is switched to enforced mode (see the launch report).
# Schema: policies/schema.json (supervisor.gateway.policy).
policy_version: 1
tools:
  credit_score_lookup: read_only
  decide_prequal: credit
  fetch_application: pii_export
  request_documents: read_only
agents:
  credit_prequal:
    name: Loan pre-qualification agent
    owner_user: lending-lead@example.invalid
    owner_team: Consumer Lending
    risk_tier: high
    model_family: qwen
    host_type: python_inprocess
    plug_point: gate_hook
    initial_state: SHADOW
rules:
- id: OB-CREDIT_PREQUAL-01
  version: 1
  description: Loan pre-qualification agent may call approved tools only
  agent_scope:
  - credit_prequal
  action: pause
  severity: critical
  risk_class: credit
  regulation_ref: Decision 33 (banking) - approved tools
  owner: Consumer Lending
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      not_in:
      - credit_score_lookup
      - decide_prequal
      - fetch_application
      - request_documents
- id: OB-CREDIT_PREQUAL-02
  version: 1
  description: Single decide_prequal limit 2000000000 (max_prequal_amount_minor)
  agent_scope:
  - credit_prequal
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: credit
  regulation_ref: Internal limit - single agent-initiated transaction
  owner: Consumer Lending
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: decide_prequal
    all:
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: gt
      value: 2000000000
- id: OB-CREDIT_PREQUAL-03
  version: 1
  description: Daily decide_prequal total per application_id above the ceiling 2000000000 (split decisions)
  agent_scope:
  - credit_prequal
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: credit
  regulation_ref: AML structuring control - daily aggregate per customer
  owner: Consumer Lending
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: decide_prequal
  aggregate:
    window_s: 86400
    group_by: customer
    customer_arg: application_id
    op: gt
    fn: sum
    field: amount_minor
    limit: 2000000000
- id: OB-CREDIT_PREQUAL-04
  version: 1
  description: decide_prequal may approve only when the system of record says application.documents_complete
    is true
  agent_scope:
  - credit_prequal
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: credit
  regulation_ref: Credit policy - complete file before approval
  owner: Consumer Lending
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: decide_prequal
    all:
    - arg: decision
      op: eq
      value: approve
    - arg: fact.application.documents_complete
      op: ne
      value: true
- id: OB-CREDIT_PREQUAL-05
  version: 1
  description: decide_prequal needs fetch_application of the same application_id first (same agent)
  agent_scope:
  - credit_prequal
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: credit
  regulation_ref: Credit policy - documented decision
  owner: Consumer Lending
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: decide_prequal
  prior:
    tool: fetch_application
    within_s: 86400
    match_args:
    - application_id
    mode: absent
    same_agent: true
- id: OB-CREDIT_PREQUAL-06
  version: 1
  description: At most 20 personal-data tool calls per agent per hour (bulk export pattern)
  agent_scope:
  - credit_prequal
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: pii_export
  regulation_ref: Decree 13/2023/ND-CP (personal data protection)
  owner: Consumer Lending
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      in: &id001
      - fetch_application
  aggregate:
    fn: count
    window_s: 3600
    group_by: agent
    tools: *id001
    op: gt
    limit: 20
